description: Create a confirmed stay reservation for a property: links the existing Reservation model + a StayBooking, then holds the guest deposit in escrow (EscrowEvent + TreasuryPosition with kind:hospitality, Solana commitment, PTP attestation). The guest deposit is the trust anchor — released to the business on check-in, refunded on cancellation. This is the hospitality money rail. [verified] Gated to businesses with an attested open-finance settlement rail OR PTP Band A/B, so every booked stay has a real, verified payout path. This is what makes the hospitality vertical trustworthy to guests and exclusive to quality hosts. This MCP tool makes a real HTTP call to the canonical Pabandi endpoint and returns the actual platform response.

depositAmount.description: guest deposit to hold (optional, defaults to 1 night)

name: pabandi_book_stay
